main_text.head: TYPOGRAPHI
main_text.p: ὁ βίος βραχὺς, ἡ δὲ τέχνη μακρή, vita brevis, ars longa: Operæ pretium duximus, tractulum hunc (Excellentissimi Clarissimique Viri D. Florentii Schuyl P. M. institutionum ac Botanices in florentissimâ hac Lugduno-Batavâ Academiâ Professoris publici vigilantissimi) flagranti desiderio à plurimis tam diu exspectatum, ex scriptis quantum possibile depromptum, typis evulgare ac publici juris facere. De febribus solummodò restat; exoptandum quidem esset ut ad finem perduxisset huncce libellum, &tanto Viro ætatis flore atque vigore gaudenti illachrymabilis mors pepercisset, quo plures studiorum fructus hominum fraga-

page.notes: Greek line transcribed as printed with its accents as far as legible; the first Greek word is in a decorative form and may differ slightly. The word "tractulum" is printed as shown (likely tractatulum-type abbreviation in print); "Schuyl" and "tanto" are as printed. Running head reads "TYPOGRAPHI" in small capitals.
